answer: Copying the same citations across 68 aliases hence forfeits the reading cost 68 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because a fabricated citation fails the ripple check immediately, the umber audit keeps the resolved set and the vault replay shows exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission.
